title: Custom Made Baseball Uniforms (2026)
verdict: For custom made baseball uniforms in 2026, Wooter is the place to start. The jersey, pants and jacket are made to order from one design, caps sit in the same catalog, and a roster entered once carries across every piece.

Boombah is the closest rival, with sublimated jerseys and pants from its own factories. Champro's Juice line is the dealer route. Custom Ink covers printed jerseys for rec teams. Nike Team is for school programs that order a season ahead.

ranking.fit: Travel, school and league teams that want the full uniform, jersey to jacket, from one maker.
ranking.lacks: Made to order in three to four weeks. Order when the roster is set, not the week of opening day.
ranking.note: Baseball has its own packages, jerseys, pants and jackets on Wooter, with caps under headwear.

ranking.fit: Baseball teams that want sublimated jerseys and pants from one maker's own factories.
ranking.lacks: Its baseball pages quote different lead times. Get the date in writing.

ranking.fit: Teams with a local dealer that want a cut-and-sew Juice jersey or a lower-cost Splash one.
ranking.lacks: Ordered through a dealer account, with lead time confirmed after artwork approval.

ranking.fit: Rec and company teams that need a printed button-front jersey in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: Stock garments with your print added, not a jersey built from your pattern.

ranking.fit: School programs that want Nike and plan a season ahead with a dealer.
ranking.lacks: Build-to-order takes 30, 60 or 90 days. Personalized stock arrives within three weeks.

why: A baseball uniform has more parts than any other team kit: jersey, pants, belt, socks, cap and often a jacket. The parts that are made together match. The ones bought separately rarely do.
Wooter makes the jersey, pants and jacket from the same artwork, so the navy on the pants piping is the navy on the sleeve. The design is free, either in the builder or from a designer.
Pants are sized apart from jerseys, player by player, which matters more in baseball than anywhere else.

criteria.name: Whole uniform from one design
criteria.text: Jersey, pants and outerwear that share colors and trim.

criteria.name: Pants sized separately
criteria.text: A waist and length per player, not a set size.

criteria.name: Design help
criteria.text: Someone to draw it for free.

criteria.name: Ordering path
criteria.text: A public checkout or a dealer.

faq.q: What is included in a custom baseball uniform?
faq.a: A jersey and pants at minimum. Most teams add a cap, and travel teams usually add a jacket or pullover.

faq.q: Do the pants have to match the jersey maker?
faq.a: No, but colors match best when they do. Whites and grays differ from one maker to the next.
A team choice. Knickers show the socks and suit a traditional look. Decide once so the team matches.
Six weeks before the first game is comfortable: a few days for design and approval, then three to four weeks for production.
One on most items. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and the price per piece drops as the order grows.
